quote: > **`hook`** writes nothing to stderr and always exits 0. **`mcp`** writes only MCP frames on stdout. Neither has a human design surface.

claim: `hook` and `mcp` are Unix clients under the new directory and euid checks, so a refused directory or a mismatched peer must reach `hook` only as a fail-open with no stderr and exit 0, and must put nothing but MCP frames on `mcp`'s stdout.
